scaffoldingPolicies.description: Requested clue, guided alignment, then a demonstrated answer after two misses. No timed failure.
Hearing the word again is free. Help then stretches the target sound (clue), then models it or takes away a choice (guided), and shows the answer last, after two misses. No timed failure.

The first rhyme turns of a visit: once the question has been heard, the words are printed under the pictures with their rhyming endings in gold, so a child can see the pattern she is listening for (D234). The words are help, given by the game at the start of the turn and recorded as visual support. Help never steps down, so the stretch (a clue) is left out here: Help models the pairs, and shows the answer after two misses.
